blind_row_selection_rule.classification: retain every row whose independent Schneider reaction-class field is exactly class 10 functional-group addition
blind_row_selection_rule.source_only_completeness: before reading its product field, retain a class-10 row only when the atom-mapped reactant side has exactly two dot-separated components, every mapped atom identity is unique, every non-hydrogen atom is mapped, and at least one source bond has explicit multiplicity greater than one
blind_row_selection_rule.outcome_inaccessibility: the product field, product component count, product atom-map inventory and product adjacency are forbidden to the selector and prediction program
blind_row_selection_rule.ordering: retain every qualifying identity in train then validation then test file order without a row limit, random draw, favorable-only filter or major-product selector
postseal_targets: exact source and product atom-map inventory
exact source-component ownership of every newly formed product bond
exact source multiple-bond support and target bond-order correspondence
every favorable adverse absent malformed and unresolved qualifying row

native_arithmetic_boundary: No external numerical zero, signed, decimal, continuum or conventional structure inscription enters native forcing; structural absence is EmptyOne.
